scope: One user-supplied 2026 Clinical Cancer Research main PDF read in full, with source-linked Methods, clinical, omics, prognosis and model-performance sentences. The separate supplementary files were not supplied.
verification: Each source sentence was visually checked on the registered PDF page and matched to the extracted text. Synthetic templates accept user facts only and do not transfer COPE findings.

papers.title: Serial circulating tumour DNA monitoring in first-line advanced NSCLC (COPE): a randomized, two-arm non-comparative phase II trial
papers.boundary: The historical-benchmark criterion was met, but the noncomparative design and absence of a mandated ctDNA action algorithm do not establish strategy benefit. Molecular-response results are exploratory associations without independent prognostic or treatment-predictive validation; external supplements were not supplied.

records.title: Serial circulating tumour DNA monitoring in first-line advanced NSCLC (COPE): a randomized, two-arm non-comparative phase II trial

source.source_sentence: No formal hypothesis test between arms was planned; Arm B outcomes were summarized descriptively.

records.use_scenario: Explain that randomization supplied balance or contemporaneous context without authorizing a formal efficacy comparison.
records.rewrite_template: No formal hypothesis test between [groups] was planned; outcomes in [contextual group] were summarized descriptively.
records.evidence_boundary: Do not label the numerical difference significant, nonsignificant, beneficial, harmful or equivalent when the comparison was not planned or tested.

records.title: Serial circulating tumour DNA monitoring in first-line advanced NSCLC (COPE): a randomized, two-arm non-comparative phase II trial

source.source_sentence: Molecular-response analyses used a 1-month landmark because classification required an early on-treatment sample, thereby reducing but not eliminating immortal-time bias.

records.use_scenario: State why a landmark was used when biomarker grouping requires postbaseline evidence.
records.rewrite_template: [Biomarker-response] analyses used a [time]-landmark because classification required [postbaseline evidence], thereby reducing but not eliminating immortal-time bias.
records.evidence_boundary: A landmark can reduce but not eliminate immortal-time bias and does not resolve missingness, selection bias or variable sampling windows.

records.title: Serial circulating tumour DNA monitoring in first-line advanced NSCLC (COPE): a randomized, two-arm non-comparative phase II trial

source.source_sentence: A multivariable model was not fitted because of the limited size and event count of the response groups; independent prognostic value was therefore not established.

records.use_scenario: Explain why exploratory outcome associations cannot be described as independently prognostic.
records.rewrite_template: A multivariable model was not fitted because of [sample-size/event-count constraint]; independent prognostic value was therefore not established.
records.evidence_boundary: Not established is not evidence of no independent value, but it prohibits an independent-prognostic-factor claim.

records.title: Serial circulating tumour DNA monitoring in first-line advanced NSCLC (COPE): a randomized, two-arm non-comparative phase II trial

source.source_locator: Results - Primary outcome: overall survival, physical p17
source.source_sentence: The lower bound of the 95% CI exceeded the prespecified 40% historical benchmark, while the CI included the 50% target (Figure 2A).

records.use_scenario: Report that an interval clears a historical criterion while remaining compatible with a separate target value.
records.rewrite_template: The lower bound of the [confidence interval] exceeded the prespecified [historical benchmark], while the interval included the [target value].
records.evidence_boundary: This supports the prespecified one-sample historical-benchmark statement only; it does not demonstrate intervention benefit, between-group superiority or adequacy against contemporary care.

records.title: Serial circulating tumour DNA monitoring in first-line advanced NSCLC (COPE): a randomized, two-arm non-comparative phase II trial

source.source_locator: Results - Baseline genomic characterization, physical p17
source.source_sentence: The plasma assay was reportable in all 112 tested patients and yielded contributory genomic information in 32 of 35 patients with noncontributory or unavailable tissue testing, increasing overall baseline genotyping success from 69% with tissue alone to 97% with tissue plus plasma.

records.use_scenario: Describe how a liquid-biopsy assay complements a reference tissue workflow with explicit denominators.
records.rewrite_template: [Assay] was reportable in [n/N] and yielded contributory information in [x/y] patients with [reference-test limitation], increasing [workflow metric] from [a] with [single modality] to [b] with [combined modalities].
records.evidence_boundary: Operational yield and genotyping success are not diagnostic sensitivity, treatment matching benefit, clinical utility or survival benefit.

records.title: Serial circulating tumour DNA monitoring in first-line advanced NSCLC (COPE): a randomized, two-arm non-comparative phase II trial

source.source_sentence: Early on-treatment ctDNA clearance was associated with higher response rates and longer progression-free and overall survival, although independent prognostic value was not established.

records.use_scenario: Summarize a positive molecular-response association while retaining the lack of adjusted prognostic validation.
records.rewrite_template: [Early biomarker change] was associated with [higher/lower response] and [longer/shorter time-to-event outcomes], although independent prognostic value was not established.
records.evidence_boundary: Use association language only; do not infer causation, treatment prediction, interaction or benefit from monitoring.

records.title: Serial circulating tumour DNA monitoring in first-line advanced NSCLC (COPE): a randomized, two-arm non-comparative phase II trial

source.source_locator: Results - Integration of molecular and volumetric response, physical p20
source.source_sentence: The composite endpoint showed numerically higher prognostic discrimination than molecular response alone for PFS (c-index 0.74, 95% CI 0.54-0.85 v 0.70, 95% CI 0.35-0.86; P=0.768) and similar discrimination for OS (0.77, 95% CI 0.47-0.88 v 0.77, 95% CI 0.35-0.87; P=0.958); neither difference was statistically significant.

records.use_scenario: Report numerical model-performance differences that do not establish incremental discrimination.
records.rewrite_template: [Composite model] showed numerically [higher/lower] discrimination than [reference model] for [endpoint 1] ([estimates and P value]) and similar discrimination for [endpoint 2] ([estimates and P value]); neither difference was statistically significant.
records.evidence_boundary: Do not claim improved prediction, incremental clinical value, validation or equivalence. Preserve the comparison, uncertainty and validation setting.

records.title: Serial circulating tumour DNA monitoring in first-line advanced NSCLC (COPE): a randomized, two-arm non-comparative phase II trial

source.source_sentence: Because the trial was not powered for a between-arm comparison and no predefined ctDNA action algorithm was mandated, these results do not establish benefit or harm from serial ctDNA monitoring.

records.use_scenario: Constrain a strategy conclusion when numerical arm differences are not supported by a planned comparison or action algorithm.
records.rewrite_template: Because the trial was not powered for [between-group comparison] and no predefined [biomarker-guided action algorithm] was mandated, these results do not establish benefit or harm from [monitoring strategy].
records.evidence_boundary: This is an untested or unestablished strategy effect, not a nonsignificant comparison and not evidence that the strategy is ineffective or harmful.
